codename: Max 账号显示组织停用
story: 作者称 Max 5x 账号在 6 月 7 日被停用，官方 Claude Code CLI 提示组织停用，申诉表单又跳回聊天页。维护者说明此仓库无法恢复账号。停用原因和恢复结果未证实，议题关闭不等于恢复。
story_en: A Max 5x subscriber reported disabled access on June 7, an organization-disabled error in the official Claude Code CLI, and an appeal form redirecting to chat. A maintainer said this tracker could not restore accounts. The cause and outcome remain unverified; issue closure did not establish restoration.
evidence: Original issue body and dated maintainer reply were visible. Account identifiers and the author's unverified cause speculation were omitted.

codename: 用过几天 Claude Code，申诉被拒
codename_en: Claude Code access lost; appeal denied
story: 原帖作者称，订阅 Pro 后在 8 月 3 日至 7 日使用 Claude Code，8 月 8 日收到账号被封的邮件。提交申诉后又收到无法解封的回复。作者表示不清楚具体原因；本站未核实平台认定或停用缘由。
story_en: The author said they subscribed to Pro, used Claude Code from August 3 to 7, and received a ban email on August 8. Their subsequent appeal was denied. They did not know the specific reason; this summary does not independently verify the provider's decision or its cause.
evidence: Original Reddit post and the author's clarification were visible. Indexed post date was August 27, 2026; the incident date is explicit in the original body.

story: 作者称 Pro 账号从 6 月 7 日起网页登录空白，Codex CLI 报 401，支持端却显示账号活跃。已申诉，6 月 16 日支持回复将查看工单；原帖未确认恢复或具体原因。
story_en: A Pro user reported blank web access and Codex CLI authentication failures from June 7, although support reportedly saw an active account. They had appealed. Support offered to inspect the case on June 16; restoration and cause were not established.
evidence: Complete first-person post and support reply visible; private identifiers omitted.

codename: Pro 账号在夜间任务中停用
codename_en: Pro account lost during a task
story: 作者称 Pro 账号在 6 月 9 日运行 Codex 夜间任务时被停用，并已申诉。6 月 14 日论坛支持称存在审核标记，申诉待专门团队处理；具体原因未说明，帖子关闭不代表账号恢复。
story_en: A Pro user reported a June 9 deactivation during an overnight Codex task. Forum support later cited a moderation flag and a pending appeal. Neither the specific reason nor a later restoration was established.
evidence: Complete original timeline and dated support reply visible; private identifiers omitted.

codename: Pro 20x 恢复后套餐成免费版
story: 作者称 Pro 20x 在 6 月 25 日失去访问，平时使用 Codex CLI、app-server 和应用。7 月 3 日更新称账号已恢复，但套餐成了 Free；通知和恢复均为作者自述，不应写成至今仍封禁。
story_en: A Pro 20x Codex user reported losing access on June 25. On July 3, they reported restoration after an email acknowledging an incorrect deactivation, but the subscription showed Free. This is a reported restoration, not an established ongoing ban.
evidence: Original post and direct author follow-up visible; private email authenticity not independently verified.

story: 帖主称约半年后重新使用 Antigravity 时发现权限被停用，持有 Google AI Pro，但不知道何时开始及具体原因。10月29日回帖称，申诉、更新及重新登录后仍受限。
story_en: An AI Pro subscriber reported discovering disabled Antigravity access after roughly six months away. The restriction date and cause were unknown. An October 29 follow-up said access remained disabled after an appeal, an app update and another sign-in.
evidence: Original post and author follow-ups were readable; no private records were checked.

story: 作者称11月14日开发时，官方 Antigravity 客户端提示服务因违反条款被禁用，工作中断。已提交申诉，11月15日回复仍无法使用；套餐及具体触发原因未得到确认。
story_en: The author reported that Antigravity’s official client disabled service during development on November 14. They had appealed and said on November 15 that it still failed. No subscription tier or independently confirmed enforcement trigger was provided.
evidence: Original issue and author follow-up were readable; repository labels do not verify the account decision.

codename: 能登录但模型仍不可用
story: 帖主称 Antigravity 此前无法登录，申诉后能登录了，但模型调用仍提示服务被禁用，连简单消息也失败。原帖未给套餐、停用开始日期或完整恢复结果。
story_en: The author reported being able to sign in after appealing an Antigravity restriction, but model requests still failed, including a simple message. No subscription tier, initial incident date or confirmed full restoration was provided.
evidence: Original post and a November 11 general response were readable.
